question: What communicative claim is made about the arrangement of the yoginī row such that it is to be disclosed to a specific person?
premises: The arrangement of the yoginī row is a defined subject.
The speaker will tell it to the addressee.
The addressee is addressed as beloved.
inference: The speaker undertakes to disclose the arrangement of the yoginī row to the beloved addressee.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, I shall tell you the arrangement of the yoginī row.
